method: Blind re-labeling of 60 random candidates (fixed seed) by two independent LLM judges that never saw the published labels.

rows.metric: Keep/drop agreement: published vs judge A
rows.note: Does the video actually teach AI?

rows.metric: Keep/drop agreement: published vs judge B

rows.note: Ceiling: how much two careful raters agree with each other.

rows.metric: Topic agreement: published vs judge A
rows.note: Same one of 18 trail topics, among videos both kept.

rows.metric: Topic agreement: published vs judge B
rows.note: Neighbouring topics (e.g. training vs nn-basics) count as misses.

rows.metric: Published label outvoted by both judges
rows.note: Each was reviewed; fixes go into overrides.json.
